yaml:
# HISS alerting and backup B1 prerequisites (RKE2 readiness stage plan 2026-10-24, R1-4 and R1-5, user approval
# "전부 승인 (권장)"; plan §4.1 BK-P6 and AL-P4). Setup applies these objects with server-side apply under the
# opensphere-setup-hiss field manager (prepare-hiss); Cluster Manager never creates or changes them.
#
# Cluster Manager's runtime ServiceAccount gets:
# - in monitoring: update of its core alert rule (opensphere-core-alerts) and create/update/delete of one
#   AlertmanagerConfig (opensphere-alert-emergency, the temporary emergency route, A-D1), plus get of the Secret of the
#   same name. Create of a PrometheusRule and every monitoring Secret read are already in the kube-prometheus-stack
#   executor Role; they are repeated here by name so this set does not depend on that Role's breadth.
# - in longhorn-system (BK-P6): update of the default BackupTarget, recurring jobs, reads of backups and backup volumes,
#   and update of Longhorn volumes for their group labels.
# No Secret writes: the emergency receiver Secret, the Longhorn store Secrets (opensphere-backup-*) and the etcd S3
# Secret are written by Setup from a protected input (prepare-hiss-secret). No delete of backups or backup targets.
#
# Four admission policies fence the new writes to their reviewed shape. They match only Cluster Manager's runtime
# ServiceAccount and deny.
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: opensphere-hiss-core-alerts
  namespace: monitoring
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
rules:
  - apiGroups: ["monitoring.coreos.com"]
    resources: ["prometheusrules"]
    verbs: ["create"]
  - apiGroups: ["monitoring.coreos.com"]
    resources: ["prometheusrules"]
    resourceNames: ["opensphere-core-alerts"]
    verbs: ["get", "update", "patch", "delete"]
  - apiGroups: ["monitoring.coreos.com"]
    resources: ["alertmanagerconfigs"]
    verbs: ["create"]
  - apiGroups: ["monitoring.coreos.com"]
    resources: ["alertmanagerconfigs"]
    resourceNames: ["opensphere-alert-emergency"]
    verbs: ["get", "update", "patch", "delete"]
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: ["secrets"]
    resourceNames: ["opensphere-alert-emergency"]
    verbs: ["get"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: opensphere-hiss-core-alerts
  namespace: monitoring
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: Role
  name: opensphere-hiss-core-alerts
subjects:
  - kind: ServiceAccount
    name: opensphere-cluster-manager-runtime
    namespace: opensphere-console
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: opensphere-hiss-backup-executor
  namespace: longhorn-system
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
rules:
  - apiGroups: ["longhorn.io"]
    resources: ["backuptargets"]
    verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]
  - apiGroups: ["longhorn.io"]
    resources: ["backuptargets"]
    resourceNames: ["default"]
    verbs: ["update", "patch"]
  - apiGroups: ["longhorn.io"]
    resources: ["recurringjobs"]
    verbs: ["get", "list", "watch", "create", "update", "patch", "delete"]
  - apiGroups: ["longhorn.io"]
    resources: ["backups", "backupvolumes"]
    verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]
  - apiGroups: ["longhorn.io"]
    resources: ["volumes"]
    verbs: ["get", "list", "watch", "update", "patch"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: opensphere-hiss-backup-executor
  namespace: longhorn-system
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: Role
  name: opensphere-hiss-backup-executor
subjects:
  - kind: ServiceAccount
    name: opensphere-cluster-manager-runtime
    namespace: opensphere-console
---
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy
metadata:
  name: opensphere-hiss-alert-emergency-route
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
spec:
  # With alertmanagerConfigMatcherStrategy OnNamespaceExceptForAlertmanagerNamespace an AlertmanagerConfig in monitoring
  # receives every alert. Cluster Manager may write only opensphere-alert-emergency there, with Slack, e-mail and webhook
  # receivers whose credentials are references to the Secret of the same name (no inline URL, no HTTP client settings),
  # so it cannot send alert content to an address of its own or pull another Secret into the Alertmanager config.
  failurePolicy: Fail
  matchConstraints:
    namespaceSelector:
      matchLabels:
        kubernetes.io/metadata.name: monitoring
    resourceRules:
      - apiGroups: ["monitoring.coreos.com"]
        apiVersions: ["*"]
        operations: ["CREATE", "UPDATE", "DELETE"]
        resources: ["alertmanagerconfigs"]
  matchConditions:
    - name: cluster-manager-identity
      expression: "request.userInfo.username == 'system:serviceaccount:opensphere-console:opensphere-cluster-manager-runtime'"
  variables:
    - name: subject
      expression: "request.operation == 'DELETE' ? oldObject : object"
    - name: receivers
      expression: "request.operation == 'DELETE' ? [] : object.spec.?receivers.orValue([])"
  validations:
    - expression: "variables.subject.metadata.name == 'opensphere-alert-emergency'"
      message: "Cluster Manager may write only the AlertmanagerConfig opensphere-alert-emergency in monitoring"
    - expression: "request.operation == 'DELETE' || (!has(object.spec.inhibitRules) && !has(object.spec.muteTimeIntervals))"
      message: "the emergency route may not inhibit or mute alerts"
    - expression: >-
        variables.receivers.all(r, !has(r.discordConfigs) && !has(r.msteamsConfigs) && !has(r.msteamsv2Configs) && !has(r.opsgenieConfigs) && !has(r.pagerdutyConfigs) && !has(r.pushoverConfigs) && !has(r.rocketchatConfigs) && !has(r.snsConfigs) && !has(r.telegramConfigs) && !has(r.victoropsConfigs) && !has(r.webexConfigs) && !has(r.wechatConfigs))
      message: "the emergency route may use only Slack, e-mail and webhook receivers"
    - expression: >-
        variables.receivers.all(r,
          r.?slackConfigs.orValue([]).all(c, !has(c.httpConfig) && c.apiURL.name == 'opensphere-alert-emergency') &&
          r.?emailConfigs.orValue([]).all(c, !has(c.authSecret) && !has(c.tlsConfig) && !has(c.headers) &&
            (!has(c.authPassword) || c.authPassword.name == 'opensphere-alert-emergency')) &&
          r.?webhookConfigs.orValue([]).all(c, !has(c.url) && !has(c.httpConfig) && has(c.urlSecret) && c.urlSecret.name == 'opensphere-alert-emergency'))
      message: "receiver credentials must be references to the Secret opensphere-alert-emergency, without inline URLs or HTTP client settings"
---
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding
metadata:
  name: opensphere-hiss-alert-emergency-route
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
spec:
  policyName: opensphere-hiss-alert-emergency-route
  validationActions: ["Deny"]
---
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy
metadata:
  name: opensphere-hiss-backup-target
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
spec:
  # Cluster Manager may point the default Longhorn backup target at an S3 store with a credential Secret named
  # opensphere-backup-*, or clear both. Nothing else on the target changes.
  failurePolicy: Fail
  matchConstraints:
    namespaceSelector:
      matchLabels:
        kubernetes.io/metadata.name: longhorn-system
    resourceRules:
      - apiGroups: ["longhorn.io"]
        apiVersions: ["*"]
        operations: ["CREATE", "UPDATE", "DELETE"]
        resources: ["backuptargets", "backuptargets/status"]
  matchConditions:
    - name: cluster-manager-identity
      expression: "request.userInfo.username == 'system:serviceaccount:opensphere-console:opensphere-cluster-manager-runtime'"
  validations:
    - expression: "request.operation == 'UPDATE' && request.?subResource.orValue('') == '' && object.metadata.name == 'default'"
      message: "Cluster Manager may only update the default backup target (no create, delete or status write)"
    - expression: >-
        object.spec.?backupTargetURL.orValue('') == '' ? object.spec.?credentialSecret.orValue('') == '' :
        (object.spec.backupTargetURL.matches('^s3://[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]@[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,31}/[A-Za-z0-9._/-]{0,200}$') &&
         object.spec.?credentialSecret.orValue('').matches('^opensphere-backup-[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,38}[a-z0-9])?$'))
      message: "the backup target is an s3:// URL with an opensphere-backup-* credential Secret, or both are empty"
    - expression: >-
        object.spec.?syncRequestedAt.orValue('') == oldObject.spec.?syncRequestedAt.orValue('') &&
        object.metadata.?labels.orValue({}) == oldObject.metadata.?labels.orValue({}) &&
        object.metadata.?annotations.orValue({}) == oldObject.metadata.?annotations.orValue({}) &&
        object.metadata.?finalizers.orValue([]) == oldObject.metadata.?finalizers.orValue([]) &&
        object.metadata.?ownerReferences.orValue([]) == oldObject.metadata.?ownerReferences.orValue([])
      message: "only the URL, credential Secret and poll interval of the backup target may change"
---
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding
metadata:
  name: opensphere-hiss-backup-target
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
spec:
  policyName: opensphere-hiss-backup-target
  validationActions: ["Deny"]
---
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy
metadata:
  name: opensphere-hiss-backup-recurring-jobs
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
spec:
  # Cluster Manager's recurring jobs are opensphere-* jobs for opensphere-* groups only: never the default group (which
  # Longhorn applies to every volume without a job label) and never another owner's job.
  failurePolicy: Fail
  matchConstraints:
    namespaceSelector:
      matchLabels:
        kubernetes.io/metadata.name: longhorn-system
    resourceRules:
      - apiGroups: ["longhorn.io"]
        apiVersions: ["*"]
        operations: ["CREATE", "UPDATE", "DELETE"]
        resources: ["recurringjobs", "recurringjobs/status"]
  matchConditions:
    - name: cluster-manager-identity
      expression: "request.userInfo.username == 'system:serviceaccount:opensphere-console:opensphere-cluster-manager-runtime'"
  variables:
    - name: subject
      expression: "request.operation == 'DELETE' ? oldObject : object"
  validations:
    - expression: "request.?subResource.orValue('') == '' && variables.subject.metadata.name.startsWith('opensphere-')"
      message: "Cluster Manager may write only opensphere-* recurring jobs (no status write)"
    - expression: >-
        request.operation == 'DELETE' ||
        (object.spec.name == object.metadata.name &&
         size(object.spec.?groups.orValue([])) >= 1 && object.spec.groups.all(g, g.startsWith('opensphere-')) &&
         object.spec.task in ['backup', 'snapshot'] &&
         object.spec.?retain.orValue(0) >= 1 && object.spec.retain <= 50 &&
         object.spec.?concurrency.orValue(0) >= 1 && object.spec.concurrency <= 3 &&
         size(object.spec.?labels.orValue({})) == 0 && size(object.spec.?parameters.orValue({})) == 0)
      message: "a recurring job runs backup or snapshot for opensphere-* groups, retain 1-50, concurrency 1-3, without labels or parameters"
---
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding
metadata:
  name: opensphere-hiss-backup-recurring-jobs
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
spec:
  policyName: opensphere-hiss-backup-recurring-jobs
  validationActions: ["Deny"]
---
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy
metadata:
  name: opensphere-hiss-backup-volume-labels
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
spec:
  # On a Longhorn volume Cluster Manager may add or remove only recurring-job-group.longhorn.io/opensphere-* labels with
  # the value enabled. The volume's spec, annotations, other labels, finalizers and owners stay as they are.
  failurePolicy: Fail
  matchConstraints:
    namespaceSelector:
      matchLabels:
        kubernetes.io/metadata.name: longhorn-system
    resourceRules:
      - apiGroups: ["longhorn.io"]
        apiVersions: ["*"]
        operations: ["CREATE", "UPDATE", "DELETE"]
        resources: ["volumes", "volumes/status"]
  matchConditions:
    - name: cluster-manager-identity
      expression: "request.userInfo.username == 'system:serviceaccount:opensphere-console:opensphere-cluster-manager-runtime'"
  variables:
    - name: prefix
      expression: "'recurring-job-group.longhorn.io/opensphere-'"
    - name: newLabels
      expression: "object != null ? object.metadata.?labels.orValue({}) : {}"
    - name: oldLabels
      expression: "oldObject != null ? oldObject.metadata.?labels.orValue({}) : {}"
  validations:
    - expression: "request.operation == 'UPDATE' && request.?subResource.orValue('') == ''"
      message: "Cluster Manager may only update a volume's labels (no create, delete or status write)"
    - expression: >-
        variables.newLabels.all(k, k.startsWith(variables.prefix) ? variables.newLabels[k] == 'enabled' :
          (k in variables.oldLabels && variables.oldLabels[k] == variables.newLabels[k])) &&
        variables.oldLabels.all(k, k.startsWith(variables.prefix) || k in variables.newLabels)
      message: "only recurring-job-group.longhorn.io/opensphere-* labels (value enabled) may be added or removed"
    - expression: >-
        object.spec == oldObject.spec &&
        object.metadata.?annotations.orValue({}) == oldObject.metadata.?annotations.orValue({}) &&
        object.metadata.?finalizers.orValue([]) == oldObject.metadata.?finalizers.orValue([]) &&
        object.metadata.?ownerReferences.orValue([]) == oldObject.metadata.?ownerReferences.orValue([])
      message: "the volume spec, annotations, finalizers and owners may not change"
---
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding
metadata:
  name: opensphere-hiss-backup-volume-labels
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
spec:
  policyName: opensphere-hiss-backup-volume-labels
  validationActions: ["Deny"]
